Doctors usually recommend stopping minoxidil (topical or oral) before a hair transplant for a few key reasons:

Scalp Healing & Bleeding

Minoxidil can sometimes increase blood flow in the scalp.

During surgery, this may cause more bleeding or make it harder for the surgeon to see clearly.

Skin Sensitivity

Minoxidil may irritate the scalp or make the skin more fragile.

A sensitive or inflamed scalp can affect how well grafts are implanted and how quickly wounds close.

Accurate Assessment

Stopping minoxidil allows the surgeon to evaluate your natural hair density and miniaturization.

This helps plan the number of grafts needed more accurately.

Post-Surgery Recovery

After the operation, the scalp needs to heal without unnecessary irritation.

Restarting minoxidil is usually advised after the transplanted grafts have settled (commonly 2–4 weeks later, depending on your surgeon’s instructions).

? In short: stopping minoxidil before surgery reduces bleeding risk, avoids scalp irritation, and helps ensure a cleaner procedure and better graft survival.

What is Exosome ? ?

Exosome hair treatment is an advanced regenerative therapy that utilizes exosomes, which are tiny vesicles (small particles) secreted by cells. These exosomes are packed with proteins, lipids, and RNA, which help to communicate and transfer information between cells. In hair restoration treatments, exosomes are used to stimulate hair growth, improve scalp health, and regenerate damaged hair follicles.

Here’s how it works:

Exosome Isolation: Exosomes are isolated from mesenchymal stem cells (MSC) or other sources that produce these vesicles. These exosomes contain a variety of growth factors, cytokines, and other molecular signals that play a role in tissue repair and regeneration.

Injection into the Scalp: The exosomes are injected into the scalp, specifically into the areas where hair thinning or loss occurs. The goal is to deliver these powerful regenerative signals directly to the hair follicles.

Stimulation of Hair Follicles: Once delivered, the exosomes promote the activation of dormant hair follicles, stimulating hair growth and improving the overall health of the scalp. They can also reduce inflammation, increase blood circulation, and encourage tissue regeneration.

Benefits:

Stimulates Hair Growth: Exosomes encourage the production of growth factors that enhance hair regeneration.

Improves Hair Follicle Health: By promoting cellular repair and rejuvenation, exosome therapy helps to strengthen weak or damaged hair follicles.

Waiting at least 12 months after finishing breastfeeding before having plastic surgery is really important — both for your health and for achieving the best possible results. Here’s why:

1. Hormones need time to settle:
During breastfeeding, your body produces high levels of hormones like prolactin and estrogen. These can cause swelling, extra volume, and looseness in your tissues. It usually takes about 9 to 12 months after stopping breastfeeding for your hormone levels to return to normal. If surgery is done before this, the results may not be stable or long-lasting.

2. Your breast shape needs to stabilize:
After you stop breastfeeding, your breast shape and size can continue to change for several months. Surgeons prefer to wait until your breasts reach their final shape so they can plan the procedure accurately. If surgery is done too early, there's a higher risk of uneven results or changes in appearance later on.

3. Safety with anesthesia and medications:
Some of the medications used during surgery can pass into breast milk and might affect your baby. That’s why it’s essential to make sure breastfeeding has completely stopped before undergoing any procedure.

4. Your body needs time to recover:
Pregnancy and breastfeeding put a lot of strain on your body. Giving yourself time to heal and regain strength ensures that your body is fully ready for surgery — which also helps you recover more smoothly afterward.

In short, waiting 12 months helps us give you the safest experience and the best, most natural-looking results. Our top priority is always your health and satisfaction, and that’s why this timing matters.

In a standard tummy tuck, even though the skin is closed in a single line, tension on the scar is carefully managed.

We use multi-layer closure, placing strong sutures in the deep fascia and connective tissue. These layers carry the majority of the tension, so the skin itself is under minimal stress.

Additionally, progressive tension sutures help distribute any pulling forces evenly across the abdominal flap, preventing the scar from stretching. By the time the skin is closed, the underlying layers already support the tissue, allowing the skin to be sutured gently and achieve a fine, smooth scar.

This method ensures that the scar heals well and tension is minimized naturally.

Buccal Fat Removal can look good on some people, but being close to 40 is an important factor doctors think about carefully.

? Possible benefits
	•	More defined cheekbones and jawline
	•	Slimmer lower face
	•	Permanent result (the fat pad doesn’t grow back)

⚠️ Why surgeons are cautious near 40

As we get closer to our 40s, the face naturally loses fat and collagen. Removing cheek fat can sometimes make the face:
	•	Look hollow or gaunt later
	•	Age faster
	•	Emphasise jowls or sagging skin

A lot of plastic surgeons now say people over mid-30s should be very carefully assessed before doing it.

?‍⚕️ What surgeons often suggest instead

Depending on your face shape, they might recommend things like:
	•	Masseter Botox (for a slimmer jaw if muscles are big)
	•	Chin or jawline contouring
	•	Small amounts of filler in cheekbones for structure
	•	Face liposuction under the chin/jaw

These options can slim the face without removing fat you might need as you age.

? When buccal fat removal can still work near 40

It may still be a good option if someone:
	•	Naturally has very full cheeks
	•	Has thick facial skin
	•	Has strong cheekbone structure
	•	Has always had “chipmunk cheeks”

⭐ Important tip

Many surgeons say wait until late 30s to see how your face ages before removing cheek fat, because once it’s gone it can’t be replaced easily.

Please stop taking the following at least 10–14 days before your surgery (unless your doctor tells you otherwise):

Blood Thinners / Pain Relievers
Aspirin (e.g. Aspirin®️, Bufferin®️)
Ibuprofen (e.g. Nurofen®️, Advil®️, Motrin®️)
Naproxen (e.g. Aleve®️, Naprosyn®️)
Diclofenac (e.g. Voltaren®️)

*Birth control pills (stop taking one month before)

Any medication containing acetylsalicylic acid (ASA)
(Note: Paracetamol / Tylenol is usually safe, but confirm with your doctor.)

2. Herbal Supplements & Natural Products

Many herbal supplements can increase bleeding risk or interfere with anesthesia. Please avoid:

Ginkgo biloba
Garlic tablets / extracts
Ginseng
St. John’s Wort
Fish oil / Omega-3
Vitamin E (high doses)
Echinacea
Kava
Valerian
Turmeric (high-dose supplements)

3. Other Substances

Alcohol (avoid completely for at least 48 hours before surgery ??)
Smoking / nicotine (including e-cigarettes, vapes, patches – these reduce healing ability ?)
Recreational drugs (e.g. cannabis, cocaine, amphetamines – can be dangerous with anesthesia)

✅ Important Notes

Always tell your surgeon about all medications you take, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter tablets, vitamins, and herbal supplements.
If you take essential prescription medications (for heart, blood pressure, thyroid, diabetes, etc.), do not stop them without your doctor’s permission.
If you are unsure about any medication, please send us the name and dosage so we can confirm with your surgeon.

? Medications & Substances to Avoid Before Surgery

Please stop taking the following at least 10–14 days before your surgery (unless your doctor tells you otherwise):

Blood Thinners / Pain Relievers
Aspirin (e.g. Aspirin®️, Bufferin®️)
Ibuprofen (e.g. Nurofen®️, Advil®️, Motrin®️)
Naproxen (e.g. Aleve®️, Naprosyn®️)
Diclofenac (e.g. Voltaren®️)

*Birth control pills (stop taking one month before)

Any medication containing acetylsalicylic acid (ASA)
(Note: Paracetamol / Tylenol is usually safe, but confirm with your doctor.)

2. Herbal Supplements & Natural Products

Many herbal supplements can increase bleeding risk or interfere with anesthesia. Please avoid:

Ginkgo biloba
Garlic tablets / extracts
Ginseng
St. John’s Wort
Fish oil / Omega-3
Vitamin E (high doses)
Echinacea
Kava
Valerian
Turmeric (high-dose supplements)

3. Other Substances

Alcohol (avoid completely for at least 48 hours before surgery ??)
Smoking / nicotine (including e-cigarettes, vapes, patches – these reduce healing ability ?)
Recreational drugs (e.g. cannabis, cocaine, amphetamines – can be dangerous with anesthesia)

✅ Important Notes

Always tell your surgeon about all medications you take, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter tablets, vitamins, and herbal supplements.
If you take essential prescription medications (for heart, blood pressure, thyroid, diabetes, etc.), do not stop them without your doctor’s permission.
If you are unsure about any medication, please send us the name and dosage so we can confirm with your surgeon.

Ginkgo biloba

Echinacea
Kava

Alcohol (avoid completely for at least 48 hours before surgery ??)

It is a more complex operation, requires greater precision, and involves additional surgical time and expertise. In short, liposuction treats fat, while gynecomastia surgery treats glandular breast tissue (with or without fat). и почему нельзя секс:
1. Риск смещения имплантов
В первый месяц формируется капсула вокруг импланта и происходит его "фиксация". Любые резкие движения, давление на грудь или напряжение грудных мышц могут сдвинуть имплант.


2. Повышение давления и отёков
Секс — это нагрузка: ускоряется сердцебиение, повышается артериальное давление, кровь приливает к тканям. Это усиливает отёк и может замедлить заживление.


3. Риск кровотечений и гематом
При активных движениях возможно повреждение сосудов в зоне операции. Это увеличивает риск внутреннего кровотечения или образования гематом.


4. Боль и дискомфорт
В первые недели после операции грудь чувствительна, швы ещё заживают. Любые вибрации или давление будут болезненными.


5. Гигиена и инфекции
Швы и рубцы ещё уязвимы. Пот и близкий контакт повышают риск попадания бактерий в область разрезов.

Плавать в море можно уже через месяц, но с условиями: 
Если рубцы полностью зажили (нет корочек, покраснений, выделений), а вода в море чистая, то непродолжительное плавание (5-10 минут) возможно.

Что касается спорта:
примерно через 3 месяца после операции можно:

Кардио (бег, эллипс, велотренажер): Можно начинать с низкоинтенсивных тренировок (20-30 минут), постепенно увеличивая нагрузку. Прислушивайтесь к себе! Любой дискомфорт в области груди — сигнал остановиться.
Упражнения на пресс: Можно выполнять стандартные скручивания, подъемы ног. Избегайте упражнений, где нужно сильно сводить руки к корпусу или делать "планку" с большой нагрузкой на руки.
Упражнения на ноги с весом (приседания, выпады): это безопасно, так как нагрузка не затрагивает напрямую верхнюю часть тела. Начинайте с легких весов.

Упражнения на руки (бицепс, трицепс):

Лучше подождите еще примерно 1-3 месяца (до достижения полных 6 месяцев с операции). Это связано с тем, что эти упражнения напрямую нагружают грудные и подключичные мышцы, к которым крепится часть грудной мышцы. Stem cell treatments usually involve injecting cells that are expected to transform or regenerate tissue. Results can be very variable, and unfortunately many clinics oversell this with unrealistic promises.

Exosome therapy, on the other hand, uses cell-derived signaling particles. Exosomes don’t become new cells; instead, they send growth and repair signals to existing cells. In hair transplants, they’re mainly used to:

Improve graft survival
Speed up healing
Enhance hair quality and thickness over time

That said, exosomes are not mandatory. A well-planned hair transplant with correct technique and graft placement can still give excellent results without exosomes. We always see them as a supportive add-on, not the main factor.

DHI and Sapphire FUE are two different techniques. The package I shared is for DHI (Direct Hair Implantation), not Sapphire FUE.

In DHI, we use implanter pens to place the grafts directly without opening channels beforehand.
Sapphire FUE uses sapphire blades to open the channels first, and then the grafts are inserted manually.

⭐ Why many patients prefer DHI:

Higher density: The implanter pen allows grafts to be placed closer together, ideal for hairline and crown work.
More control: Each graft can be placed at a precise angle, depth, and direction — very important for natural results.

Aftercare & Recovery (Rhinoplasty)

Nasal cast / splint
	•	You will have a nasal splint (cast) on your nose for around 7 days
	•	This splint is removed before you travel home
	•	You will not travel with a cast
	•	After removal, small skin-coloured tapes may be applied for support, but these are optional and mainly for swelling control

Nasal packing (plugging)
	•	We do not routinely use full nasal packing
	•	If any internal support is used, it is usually soft silicone splints, not painful packing
	•	These are typically removed within 1–2 days
	•	Most patients can breathe through the nose quite soon after surgery

Swelling & bruising
	•	Most visible swelling and bruising improves significantly within 7–10 days
	•	By 2 weeks, the majority of patients feel comfortable returning to work and social activities
	•	Some mild swelling (especially at the tip) can persist, but it’s usually not noticeable to others

Returning to work
	•	2 weeks off work is usually sufficient
	•	By that time:
	•	The cast is removed
	•	No visible bruising for most patients
	•	No mandatory tape on the nose
	•	If your job is not physically demanding, many patients return even earlier, but 2 weeks is a safe and realistic plan

Aftercare support
	•	You’ll receive:
	•	Clear aftercare instructions

Please stop taking the following at least 10–14 days before your surgery (unless your doctor tells you otherwise):

Blood Thinners / Pain Relievers

Ibuprofen (e.g. Nurofen®️, Advil®️, Motrin®️)

Diclofenac (e.g. Voltaren®️)

Ginkgo biloba
Garlic tablets / extracts
Ginseng
St. John’s Wort
Fish oil / Omega-3
Vitamin E (high doses)
Echinacea
Kava
Valerian

Alcohol (avoid completely for at least 48 hours before surgery ??)

A mid-face lift works by repositioning the cheek fat pads and supporting tissues back to their natural, youthful position. This restores cheek volume, improves under-eye hollowness, and softens the nasolabial area. It does not pull on the eyes or change their shape.

A temporal lift focuses on the outer brow and temple area. Its purpose is to gently lift heaviness or drooping in the temple and upper cheek region, creating a refreshed and rested appearance. Importantly, when performed correctly, a temporal lift does not change the eye shape.

The “cat-eye” look happens when the outer corners of the eyes are deliberately pulled upward and outward (often through procedures specifically designed to elongate or tilt the eyes). This is a different aesthetic goal and is not what we aim for in a temporal lift.

Just a quick guide on the bras after your surgery so you know what to expect:

Right after your surgery (first 0–2 weeks), you’ll be placed in a post-surgical compression bra, this will be provided by us, so you don’t need to buy anything for this stage. Between 6–12 weeks, you can start wearing light support bras or soft sports bras, still ideally without underwire while everything continues to settle.

Will it hurt?

No — the procedure is designed to be as comfortable as possible thanks to sedation.

Sedation is a medical technique used to help you feel completely relaxed and at ease during the procedure. It is administered by a specialized anesthesia doctor, who monitors you throughout the entire process.

With sedation:
• You will feel calm and stress-free
• You may feel sleepy or lightly drowsy
• You will not feel pain during the procedure
• Many patients don’t even remember the procedure afterward

It is important to note that this is not general anesthesia — you will continue to breathe on your own and your vital signs will be closely monitored at all times.

Our goal is to ensure you have a comfortable, pain-free, and relaxed experience from start to finish.

What is DHI ? 

DHI stands for Direct Hair Implantation.

It is an advanced hair transplant technique where hair follicles are extracted one by one from the donor area and then directly implanted into the recipient area using a special medical pen (called a Choi pen).

Unlike traditional methods, DHI does not require opening channels beforehand. This allows for:
• More precise implantation
• Higher density
• A more natural-looking result
• Faster recovery time

It is a safe and effective method, especially suitable for patients who want a dense and natural hairline.

DHI Hair Transplant is performed by a highly experienced and specialized medical team to ensure the best possible results:

• 1 Anesthesia Doctor – responsible for your comfort and sedation
• 1 Lead Doctor – overseeing and performing the transplant procedure
• 1 Doctor – dedicated to harvesting and collecting the grafts
• 3 Skilled Technicians – assisting throughout the procedure

Our team brings years of expertise and precision to help you achieve natural, long-lasting results and restore your hair with confidence.
